/*selectMnthngTaskwkList 월간업무보고 목록 조회 - 이승재*/ D.BIZ_YR /*사업시작일자*/ , A.RESRCE_NO /*자원번호*/ , B.PVSN_RESRCE_NM /*자원번호*/ , C.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO /*서비스실행사업번호*/ , C.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NM /*서비스실행사업명*/ , B.RSFR_INST_NO AS INST_NO /*기관번호*/ , (SELECT INST_NM FROM SAA000 WHERE INST_NO = B.RSFR_INST_NO) AS INST_NM /*기관명*/ , A.RPT_SE_CD /*보고구분코드*/ , A.TASKWK_RPT_SN /*업무보고일련번호*/ , DEC_B64(F.FLNM_ENCPT) AS FLNM_ENCPT /*담당자명*/ , DEC_B64(F.MBL_TELNO_ENCPT) AS MBL_TELNO_ENCPT /*담당자 연락처*/ , A.APLY_YMD /*신청일자*/ , A.SEMSTR_SE_CD /*학기 구분코드*/ , A.RPT_MM /*보고월*/ , (SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'SEMSTR_SE_CD' AND CMMNS_CD_VALUE = A.SEMSTR_SE_CD) AS SEMSTR_SE_NM /*학기명*/ , (SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'MM_SE_CD' AND CMMNS_CD_VALUE = A.RPT_MM) AS RPT_MM_NM /*보고월명*/ , B.PVSN_BGNG_YMD /*교육시작일자*/ , B.PVSN_END_YMD /*교육종료일자*/
FROM AFA210 A /*업무보고 테이블*/ INNER JOIN SDA100 B /*자원기본 테이블*/ ON A.RESRCE_NO = B.RESRCE_NO INNER JOIN SDA420 AS C ON /*서비스실행사업 테이블*/ B.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO = C.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO INNER JOIN SDA400 AS D /*서비스사업 테이블*/ ON C.SRVC_BIZ_NO = D.SRVC_BIZ_NO LEFT JOIN SCA100 F ON F.ENFSN_NO = A.APLY_PIC_NO WHERE 1=1 AND D.BIZ_YR LIKE #{BIZ_YR} || '%' AND B.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO LIKE #{SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO} || '%' AND A.RESRCE_NO LIKE #{RESRCE_NO} || '%' AND B.RSFR_INST_NO LIKE #{INST_NO} || '%' AND A.RPT_SE_CD = '02' AND A.DEL_YN = 'N' AND A.SEMSTR_SE_CD LIKE #{SEMSTR_SE_CD} || '%' AND A.RPT_MM LIKE #{RPT_MM} || '%' AND DEC_B64(F.FLNM_ENCPT) LIKE #{PIC_NM} || '%'

/*selectMnthngTaskwkInqCnd 월간업무보고 상세 - 기본사항 조회 - 이승재*/ SELECT A.RESRCE_NO /*자원번호*/ , B.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO /*서비스실행사업번호*/ , C.INST_NO /*기관번호*/ , A.RPT_SE_CD /*보고구분코드*/ , A.TASKWK_RPT_SN /*업무보고일련번호*/ , A.RPT_CN /*보고내용*/ , A.ATFINO /*첨부파일번호*/ , A.SEMSTR_SE_CD /*학기구분코드*/ , A.RPT_MM /*보고월*/ , A.APLY_YMD /*신청일자(등록일자)*/ , F.BIZ_YR /*사업연도*/ , DEC_B64(D.FLNM_ENCPT) AS APLY_PIC_NM /*담당자명*/ , DEC_B64(D.MBL_TELNO_ENCPT) AS MBL_TELNO_ENCPT /*담당자 휴대폰번호*/ FROM AFA210 AS A /*업무보고 테이블*/ JOIN SDA100 AS B /*자원기본 테이블*/ ON A.RESRCE_NO = B.RESRCE_NO /*자원번호*/ JOIN SAA000 AS C /*통합기관 테이블*/ ON B.RSFR_INST_NO = C.INST_NO /*기관번호*/ JOIN SCA100 D /*종사자 테이블*/ ON D.ENFSN_NO = A.APLY_PIC_NO /*종사자번호*/ JOIN SDA420 E ON E.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO = B.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO /*서비스실행사업번호*/ JOIN SDA400 F ON F.SRVC_BIZ_NO = E.SRVC_BIZ_NO /*서비스사업번호*/ WHERE 1=1 AND A.TASKWK_RPT_SN = #{TASKWK_RPT_SN} /*업무보고일련번호*/ AND A.RESRCE_NO = #{RESRCE_NO} /*자원번호*/ AND A.RPT_SE_CD = #{RPT_SE_CD} /*보고구분코드*/ AND C.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = #{UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD} /*단위업무구분코드*/ AND A.DEL_YN = 'N' /*삭제여부*/

/*selectMnthngOperHrPrecon 월간업무보고 상세 - 월간시수 현황 조회 - 이승재*/ SELECT (SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 WHERE CMMNS_CD_VALUE = A.SEMSTR_SE_CD AND CMMNS_CD_ID = 'SEMSTR_SE_CD') AS SEMSTR_SE_CD /*학기 구분코드*/ , (SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 WHERE CMMNS_CD_VALUE = A.RPT_MM AND CMMNS_CD_ID = 'MM_SE_CD') AS RPT_MM /*보고월 구분코드*/ , (SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 WHERE CMMNS_CD_VALUE = A.EDU_PROGRM_SE_CD AND CMMNS_CD_ID = 'EDU_PROGRM_SE_CD') AS EDU_PROGRM_SE_CD /*교육영역 구분코드*/ , (SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 WHERE CMMNS_CD_VALUE = A.CLRO_SE_CD AND CMMNS_CD_ID = 'CLRO_SE_CD') AS CLRO_SE_CD /*수업반 구분코드*/ , A.OPER_HR_CNT AS OPER_HR_CNT /*운영시수*/ , (SELECT SUM(OPER_HR_CNT) FROM AFA600 WHERE RESRCE_NO = A.RESRCE_NO AND CLRO_SE_CD = A.CLRO_SE_CD AND SEMSTR_SE_CD = A.SEMSTR_SE_CD AND RPT_MM <= #{RPT_MM} AND EDU_PROGRM_SE_CD = A.EDU_PROGRM_SE_CD ) AS ACCMLT_OPER_HR /*누적 운영시수*/ , (SELECT OPER_HR_CNT FROM AFA600 WHERE RESRCE_NO = A.RESRCE_NO AND CLRO_SE_CD = A.CLRO_SE_CD AND SEMSTR_SE_CD = '00' AND RPT_MM = '00' ) AS YEAR_GOAL_HR /*연간 목표시수*/ , DEC_B64(D.FLNM_ENCPT) AS FLNM_ENCPT /*담당자명*/ , DEC_B64(D.MBL_TELNO_ENCPT) as MBL_TELNO_ENCPT /*담당자 연락처*/ FROM AFA600 A /*운영시수 테이블*/ JOIN SDA100 B /*자원기본 테이블*/ ON B.RESRCE_NO = A.RESRCE_NO JOIN SDA420 C /*서비스실행사업 테이블*/ ON B.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO = C.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO LEFT JOIN SCA100 D /*종사자 테이블*/ ON A.PIC_NO = D.ENFSN_NO
WHERE A.RESRCE_NO = #{RESRCE_NO} AND A.SEMSTR_SE_CD = #{SEMSTR_SE_CD} AND A.RPT_MM = #{RPT_MM}

/*selectMnthngAtendLinkPrecon 월간업무보고 상세 - 월간출석현황, 연계현황 조회 - 이승재*/ SELECT DEC_B64(C.TRPR_NM_ENCPT) AS TRPR_NM_ENCPT /*교육생성명*/ , C.TRPR_BRTH_YMD /*생년월일*/ , (SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'SXDC_SE_CD' AND CMMNS_CD_VALUE = C.SXDC_SE_CD) AS SXDC_SE_CD /*성별*/ , F.BGNG_YMD /*이수기간(시작일자)*/ , F.END_YMD /*이수기간(시작일자)*/ , (SELECT SUM(CLASS_DAYCNT) FROM AFA700 WHERE RESRCE_NO = A.RESRCE_NO AND CASE_MNG_NO = A.CASE_MNG_NO AND CASE_MNG_ODRNO = A.CASE_MNG_ODRNO ) AS ALL_SEMSTR_CLASS_DAYCNT , (SELECT SUM(ATEND_DAYCNT) FROM AFA700 WHERE RESRCE_NO = A.RESRCE_NO AND CASE_MNG_NO = A.CASE_MNG_NO AND CASE_MNG_ODRNO = A.CASE_MNG_ODRNO ) AS ALL_SEMSTR_ATEND , (SELECT SUM(ABSNC_DAYCNT) FROM AFA700 WHERE RESRCE_NO = A.RESRCE_NO AND CASE_MNG_NO = A.CASE_MNG_NO AND CASE_MNG_ODRNO = A.CASE_MNG_ODRNO ) AS ALL_SEMSTR_ABSNC , (SELECT SUM(LATEN_DAYCNT) FROM AFA700 WHERE RESRCE_NO = A.RESRCE_NO AND CASE_MNG_NO = A.CASE_MNG_NO AND CASE_MNG_ODRNO = A.CASE_MNG_ODRNO ) AS ALL_SEMSTR_LATEN , (SELECT SUM(LRLY_DAYCNT) FROM AFA700 WHERE RESRCE_NO = A.RESRCE_NO AND CASE_MNG_NO = A.CASE_MNG_NO AND CASE_MNG_ODRNO = A.CASE_MNG_ODRNO ) AS ALL_SEMSTR_LRLY , A.CLASS_DAYCNT , A.ATEND_DAYCNT , A.ABSNC_DAYCNT , A.LATEN_DAYCNT , A.LRLY_DAYCNT , (SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'FNSH_SE_CD' AND CMMNS_CD_VALUE = E.FNSH_SE_CD) AS FNSH_SE_CD /*수료구분*/ , (SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'LINK_PRECON_SE_CD' AND CMMNS_CD_VALUE = E.LINK_PRECON_SE_CD) AS LINK_PRECON_SE_CD /*연계현황구분코드*/ , DEC_B64(D.FLNM_ENCPT) AS FLNM_ENCPT /*담당자명*/ , DEC_B64(D.MBL_TELNO_ENCPT) AS MBL_TELNO_ENCPT /*담당자 휴대폰 번호*/ , A.RPT_MM /*보고 월*/ , A.SEMSTR_SE_CD /*학기구분코드*/ FROM AFA700 A /*개인별출석현황 테이블*/ JOIN SEB100 B /*사례관리 테이블*/ ON A.CASE_MNG_NO = B.CASE_MNG_NO AND A.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = B.CASE_MNG_ODRNO JOIN SEA200 C /*대상자정보 테이블*/ ON B.TRPR_INFO_NO = C.TRPR_INFO_NO JOIN SCA100 D /*종사자 테이블*/ ON D.ENFSN_NO = A.PIC_NO JOIN AFA320 E /*참여자조사표 테이블*/ ON A.RESRCE_NO = E.RESRCE_NO AND A.CASE_MNG_NO = E.CASE_MNG_NO AND A.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = E.CASE_MNG_ODRNO JOIN AFA330 F /*교육이수일정내역 테이블*/ ON F.CASE_MNG_NO = A.CASE_MNG_NO AND F.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = A.CASE_MNG_ODRNO WHERE A.RESRCE_NO = #{RESRCE_NO} AND A.SEMSTR_SE_CD = #{SEMSTR_SE_CD} AND A.RPT_MM = #{RPT_MM}
